meta.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
meta.description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接产出移动 App 的界面图和整套界面流程图,界面默认放进手机样机中展示;可选 iOS、Android 或跨平台风格。它只生成图片,不写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求做 iOS 或 Android 移动 App 的界面概念、界面流程(如引导页、登录页等)时触发。网站、落地页、桌面仪表盘,或要求写前端代码时不适用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude directly produces mobile app screen images and full screen-flow sets, shown inside a phone mockup by default; you can pick iOS, Android, or cross-platform styling. It generates images only and writes no code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for iOS or Android mobile app screen concepts or flows, such as onboarding or auth screens. Not for websites, landing pages, desktop dashboards, or code.
